claim: A negative control passes or reports n/a silently unless the data reaches the broken path; aim each at what the recording runs, run each new negative once, and count n/a explicitly.

evidence.text: The 'XOR made plain' negative mutated the items' loop, which never undraws in the recording, and passed the replay.
A broken clipped-row path was never reached in 24,000 frames, so it stayed untested.
Two figure controls read live sprite attributes after the commit moved them and were n/a on every state.
The evict negative passed a 700-frame replay because the pool never filled.
A control changing the first LD A,n after the entry changed the mark's constant, not R's.
A leftover sys.argv MODE line made the art negatives run as normal.
